description: February 17 birthday meaning: Aquarius or Pisces cusp, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, February 17 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a February 17 birthday
paragraphs: February 17 often falls in the second-to-last degree of Aquarius, though in some years the Sun is close enough to Pisces that the exact birth time is worth confirming. Birthday number 8 brings ambition and authority. Blended with Aquarian vision and a hint of Piscean empathy, it suggests a leader who wants power used for wider good.

By noon UTC on February 17, the Sun has normally reached roughly 28° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Venus, the third of three. The Aquarius–Pisces cusp, around February 17 to February 20, joins two of the most idealistic signs in the zodiac. Born here, your Sun sign is set by year, hour and birthplace, because the Sun's entry into Pisces does not fall on the same day every year; a natal chart resolves it. Those who feel both are often described as imaginative humanitarians, combining Aquarius' ideas about how the world could be with Pisces' compassion for the people living in it. They may drift between detachment and deep feeling, and learn to use each when it helps.

sections.heading: Numerology of the February 17 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 17th, you have the compound 1 + 7 = 8 as your birthday number. The 1 brings ambition and drive, the 7 brings analysis and inner reflection, and together they feed the 8's practical authority. People born on this day are often described as strategic and independent, with good judgement about money, systems and long-term plans. They tend to think before they act, then act decisively. Read as a secondary number, the 17 is traditionally associated with quiet confidence and with achievement that comes from combining a clear vision with patient attention to detail.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same February 17 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: February 17 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 17 is the 48th day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 2 days after this birthday.

February 17 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 113 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. February 17 is also the birthday of Michael Jordan (1963), Paris Hilton (1981) and Mo Yan (1955).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 17?
faq.answer: February 17 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Aquarius. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 17?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 17 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 17th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 17?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 17 in 113 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 17?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a February 17 birthday are Michael Jordan (1963), Paris Hilton (1981) and Mo Yan (1955). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
